headline: Weathered Expanse Burns Brightest; Gutter and Palantine Berm Still Firing
war_summary: The weight of the fighting has swung to the Weathered Expanse, where six actions were logged in the last two hours and the exchange ran right up to the hour of this dispatch. Hourly losses there stand near 380 Colonial and 237 Warden, both rising, and its nine works are held five by the Wardens, one by the Colonials and three unclaimed, with Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch the busiest points. The Gutter remains the war's deepest scar, with twenty-seven actions in six hours though only four in the last two; its seven works now split four Colonial, two Warden and one unclaimed, a narrower Colonial margin than the last edition reported. Palantine Berm keeps a steady fire — four actions in two hours, losses near 121 Colonial and 116 Warden an hour — its seven works six Colonial and one Warden. Marban Hollow has gone quiet after its heavy day, as have the Nevish Line and Linn Mercy, though Linn Mercy's losses are climbing sharply and its eleven works stand eight Colonial, two Warden and one unclaimed. Godcrofts, busiest yesterday, has not fired since afternoon. The victory mark stands at thirty-four towns.
